title: Profile placement-conditioned policy memory use

hypothesis.statement: A placement-conditioned action head fits within the existing two-GPU memory budget at the target batch size

intervention.description: Instantiate the candidate head and run a fixed three-step training smoke profile without changing the baseline pipeline

constraint_audit.evidence: This plan exists to measure peak VRAM.

assumptions: Profiling at target batch size is representative of the full training path
unknowns: Peak allocated and reserved GPU memory

adopt_if: Peak allocated GPU memory remains below 20 GB on each target GPU
reject_if: Peak allocated GPU memory exceeds 22 GB or OOM occurs

rollback_description: Delete profiling-only script; no production path is changed
